ranking_rule: Within each case a method is ranked by the mean objective of its feasible runs only if at least half of its runs (15 of 30; 5 of 10) are feasible; methods with fewer feasible runs receive the worst ranks, below all qualifying methods, ordered by their number of feasible runs (more = better, ties averaged). This removes the survivorship bias of ranking by the mean feasible objective.
